declared_mapping.orientation: weight-stationary; array row r <- weight beat (63-r); array column c <- beat nibble c; beat p = SRAM words 8p-2..8p+5 low-32b (lane m = word 8p+5-m)
declared_mapping.weight_word_formula: W[r][c] = nib_{c%8}(word[509 - 8r - floor(c/8)]) for (r<63) or (r=63, c<48); row 63 cols 48..55 alias word 0; row 63 cols 56..63 = residue (word 0 after reset)
declared_mapping.math: res[c] = SAT16((sum_r W[r][c]*A[r][c]) * zero_ext(scale) >>> shift), 20-bit signed accumulate
declared_mapping.result: word k at bank (k%32)%20 addr 0x780+k = {7'b0, res[k], res[k]}
